cli.name: antigravity
cli.system_prompt_note: Answers come from Antigravity CLI print mode (agy --print), Google's CLI for free personal accounts (it replaced Gemini CLI for them on 2026-06-18). Its own agent system prompt and tool list are included (about 8.5k input tokens for a one-word prompt); every tool action is denied by --settings, so it can only answer in text. Not directly comparable with API/OpenRouter cells.
